display_title: The Saintess and Her Secret Chambers
description:
When Aristella gets chosen as the new Saintess for the Temple of Yggmentar, she has no choice but to abide the orders. However, when the goddess of destruction Yggmentar gets sealed into Aristella's body, all hell is about to break lose. Yggmentar lures the young, inexperienced priests to get into bed with her every night, and the men have no choice but to give into her temptation. Even when Aristella isn't possessed by the goddess, she finds herself lusting for the men inside the Temple. It's only a matter of time until she finds out about the dark secret of the goddess Yggmentar, and that the priests aren't exactly the type of people she thought them to be... 

(Source: Pocket Comics)
